name: Central European University
summary: Vienna-based university teaching in English; three bachelor's degrees, each in 3 years (Austrian) or 4 years (US and Austrian accreditation).

handoff.label: Apply to a bachelor's program at CEU

ib.text: IB English at 5 or above (HL or SL) exempts you from the English test. No IB points or subject minimum: admission is holistic, and Data Science and Society asks for a clear maths record.

dates.label: Round 1 deadline (all applicants; CEU financial aid open)

programmes.name: Culture, Politics and Society
programmes.about: Interdisciplinary degree in English combining political science, sociology, anthropology and cultural studies to examine how societies change; a 3-year Austrian degree, or 4 years for the US and Austrian degrees.
programmes.overview: The first year lays foundations in cultural anthropology, sociological theory and political concepts and ideologies, drawing on history, philosophy, international relations, law, public policy, gender studies and environmental studies. In year two you choose one of three multidisciplinary majors, learn research methods and complete an experiential project such as an internship, work with a faculty researcher or civic engagement. Minors in areas such as gender studies, human rights or philosophy are possible, a year at a partner university is an option, and thesis seminars lead to a final thesis. Graduates go into public policy, international organisations, NGOs, media, cultural industries and research, or on to a master's.
programmes.ib: IB English at 5 (HL or SL) covers the English test; you also write a 500-word essay on a global challenge.
programmes.selectionNote: Grades, recommendation, a 300-word motivation letter and a 500-word essay, then an interview if preselected; no subject requirement.

programmes.name: Data Science and Society
programmes.about: Data science joined with economics, politics and cognitive science in English: computational analysis and modelling applied to social questions, with one of three specialisations; 3 years (Austrian BSc) or 4 years (US BA and Austrian BSc).
programmes.overview: The first two years combine calculus, linear algebra and statistics with Python programming, algorithms, machine learning, data management and the ethics of AI, plus microeconomics and quantitative methods. In years three and four you follow one of three tracks: Economics, Politics and Policy, or Social Cognitive Science. Classes rely on discussion and collaboration, with data science projects on real-world data from business or academia, an option to study at a partner university in year three, and thesis research. Graduates head for startups, fintech, government bodies, research institutions and policy consultancies, or for master's study in data science, economics, politics or finance.
programmes.ib: A clear record in maths is expected; IB Maths HL 5 or SL 6 is named as a competitive reference point, and IB English at 5 covers the English test.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review with a sustained maths record from your transcripts; a maths test score (IB Maths HL 5 or SL 6 is competitive) is encouraged, not required.

programmes.name: Philosophy, Politics and Economics
programmes.about: PPE degree in English building foundations in philosophy, politics and economics, then one of three specialisation tracks; a 3-year Austrian degree, or 4 years for the US and Austrian degrees.
programmes.overview: Year one covers microeconomics, macroeconomics, politics, political concepts, philosophy of knowledge and ethics, along with academic writing, critical reasoning and data analysis. In year two you pick two of three pairings: Economics and Politics, Philosophy and Economics, or Politics and Philosophy, with electives from other programmes. Small seminars stress discussion; the third year offers exchange at a partner university or an experiential project such as an internship or civic work, and the later years centre on a thesis, with master's-level courses possible in year four. Graduates work in public administration, non-profits, media and advocacy, or continue to master's study in fields like international relations or finance.
programmes.ib: Maths in your final year is strongly recommended; IB English at 5 (HL or SL) covers the English test.
programmes.selectionNote: Holistic review of grades, recommendation, English, motivation and plans; an interview if preselected. No subject is required.

notes: CEU's three bachelor's degrees are taught in Vienna, Austria, not in Budapest.
Self-financing EU applicants can use all four rounds, but CEU financial aid is awarded in the first two only; tuition is €8,000 a year, and a €500 registration fee counts towards it.
You can stop after 3 years with an Austria-accredited degree or continue to 4 years for a degree accredited in both the US and Austria.
